capabilities: Write inline flashcards in ::: blocks using ::, >>, <<, <>, {} cloze, and ;; multiline delimiters
Organize cards into nested decks with #deck/ tags
Review due cards per vault, per deck, or per note, including inline review
Browse all cards in a searchable list and jump to their source line
Schedule repetitions with SM-2, storing progress in plugin data without modifying notes
extras: Manifest carries the warning: "This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff."
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to write flashcards inside regular notes and review them later, so users must move cards to a separate app or another plugin's syntax.
summary: Flashcard plugin that reads RemNote-style inline card delimiters in ::: blocks and reviews them with optional SM-2 spaced repetition.
